name: Pusher Channels (Real-time)
description: Real-time WebSocket messaging with Pusher Channels — live dashboards, chat, notifications, and collaborative features.

requiredSecrets.name: PUSHER_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: Pusher app key (safe for client-side use)

postInstallNotes:
1. Use `broadcast(channel, event, data)` on the server to push events.
2. On the client, connect with `pusher-js` using `PUSHER_KEY` and `PUSHER_CLUSTER`.
3. Expose `VITE_PUSHER_KEY` and `VITE_PUSHER_CLUSTER` for the frontend (same values, different env var names).
